Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Elective laparoscopic Cholecystectomy, [OR]  ASA status 1-2
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patient refusal Contraindications to regional anesthesia Known allergy to local anesthetics Bleeding diathesis Use of any anti-coagulants Inability to provide informed consent Severe kidney  [OR] or liver disease Inability to operate PCA system Patient with psychiatric disorders
